description_en: Executes a policy task in the task center
description_zh: 执行任务中心的策略任务
name: ProcessSoarStrategyTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy task.
>Call the [DescribeSoarStrategyTasks](~~DescribeSoarStrategyTasks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略任务ID。
>调用[DescribeSoarStrategyTasks](~~DescribeSoarStrategyTasks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The action status of the task. Valid values:
- SCHEDULE: scheduling
- PAUSE: pause
parameters.help_zh:
任务动作状态。取值：
- SCHEDULE：调度
- PAUSE：暂停
parameters.name: task_action
